concerns.text: FR-009 proposes testing niche stability by computing delta AUC/TSS between projections onto future climate and the *historical climate* using the same model trained on the historical data. If the historical‑climate performance is measured on the training data (rather than an out‑of‑sample or cross‑validated estimate), the baseline is circularly derived from the model’s fitted values, inflating performance and making the delta non‑informative. The validation target (delta AUC) must be based on an independent assessment of historical‑climate predictive skill (e.g., spatial‑block cross‑validated AUC) to avoid circular validation.

FR-006 states the species‑record threshold is "subject to the power analysis in FR-015", but FR-015 is not defined anywhere in the specification (the power analysis is actually FR-011). This broken reference prevents verification of the statistical justification for the 100‑record cutoff and undermines the scientific grounding of the filter.
